messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of accounts with healthscore stuck at 30 for >45 days, but no playbook runs. likely orphaning after connector flaps. Opening thread to propose a small sentinel + auto-nudge runbook.
Liam O'Connor: ugh, same cohort I saw in staging sample. can you post the query?
Maya Patel: query attached below. returns accounts with last_playbook_run IS NULL AND healthscore <= 30 AND last_activity > 45_days_ago.
Maya Patel: ```SELECT account_id, healthscore, last_activity, owner_id FROM accounts WHERE healthscore <= 30 AND last_playbook_run IS NULL AND last_activity < now() - interval '45 days';```
Sanjay Rao: we should be careful about mass nudge. some of these are churned or M&A. maybe add a provenance check (source != imported_legacy) + last_contacted filter.
Priya Chen: agree. also want a soft reassign step — if owner inactive for >30 days then put into unassigned queue rather than emailing customer. avoid noise.
Maya Patel: good call. propose pipeline: 1) sentinel job daily -> mark candidate + tag "stale-playbook" 2) run quick enrichment (company status) 3) if owner active -> kick soft nudge sequence (2 emails + slack nudge to owner) 4) if owner inactive -> move to unassigned + create triage task for CS Ops.
Jordan Kim: +1. Can we gate the nudge by a minimal telemetry check? like runbook only fires if last_5_events_count >= 1 in past 90 days to avoid re-engaging dead accounts.
Liam O'Connor: timeline? I can wire the sentinel query into the playbook runner this week if we lock the business rules.
Maya Patel: rough MVP: sentinel + tag + owner-nudge flow. skip enrichment for v1. target deploy Fri.
Sanjay Rao: for safety add a dry-run flag and a sampling percent. start at 5% of candidates and ramp.
Priya Chen: can we include opt-out detection? some accounts explicitly opted out of automated outreach. need to honor that field.
Maya Patel: yes — skip if opt_out_automation = true. add to query.
CS Ops Bot: playbook-runner detected new sentinel job "staleness-sentinel-v1" scheduled for 2025-03-14T08:00:00Z (dry-run=true, sample_pct=5%).
Liam O'Connor: testing plan: 1) run locally with sample set 2) run dry-run in staging (logs only) 3) enable 5% in prod -> monitor false positive rate and nudge backlash.
Jordan Kim: metrics to track: candidate count, owner-active ratio, nudge-response rate, bump in reactivation, complaint count. set alert if complaint_rate > 0.1% in first week.
Sanjay Rao: code snippet for tagging step: ```curl -X POST https://internal.cs.ops/api/tag -d '{"account_id": "<id>", "tag": "stale-playbook"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY'```
Priya Chen: will add the triage runbook doc and a template task for unassigned handoff. sending draft later today.
Maya Patel: thanks. Liam, can you pick up the sentinel PR? put a feature flag and sampling control. I'll own the playbook workflow + docs.
Liam O'Connor: got it. PR by Thu EOD.
CS Ops Bot: deploy-bot: playbook-runner PR #452 merged to staging by @liam, dry-run scheduled.
Maya Patel: once staging dry-run looks clean, we'll schedule a 30-min ops sync to approve ramping. tagging ops channel. @here
Jordan Kim: FYI — added dashboards: cs.playbook.staleness.candidates and cs.playbook.staleness.nudges. sharing link in channel.
Priya Chen: added opt-out check to the draft query and updated the triage checklist.
Sanjay Rao: noted. let's keep sample_pct at 5% for 72h then increase to 20% if no signal.
Maya Patel: final: document owner = Maya, sentinel owner = Liam, ops triage = Priya, review cadence = daily for first week. thanks all :rocket:
